title: Divisibility of Trace Codes
summary: A linear code is said to be $Δ$-divisible if the Hamming weights of all its codewords are divisible by $Δ$. The $p$-adic valuation of a code is defined as the greatest integer $t$ such that the code is $p^t$-divisible. In this paper, we establish a divisibility criterion for trace codes. Specifically, this criterion provides a systematic method to determine the $p$-adic valuation of the associated trace code, thereby extending Ward's classical divisibility criterion from standard generating sets (or matrices) to generalized generator matrices over an extension field.
